Class UtilityMap

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.UtilityMap
All Implemented Interfaces:
BiFunction<String, edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.world.State, Double>
public class UtilityMap extends Object implements BiFunction<String, edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.world.State, Double>
A simple BiFunction that defines what utility value a Tandem Tales character has in a given state and which can be easily serialized to and deserialized from a JSON file.

This object exists because a Tandem Tales story world does not define the utility of its characters, so supplementary information is needed to set the utility values of the authors and the characters in the nodes of a story graph.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • apply

      public Double apply(String character, edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.world.State state)

      Finds the utility function for the character with the given name (or the author, if the name is null) and returns that character's utility in the given state.

      If the given character does not have a utility function, 0 is returned.

      Specified by:
      apply in interface BiFunction<String, edu.uky.cs.nil.tt.world.State, Double>
